qwen_chat.w: This section lists specific amounts of unobligated funds being rescinded from various components of the Department of Homeland Security. It is a fiscal provision involving only federal agencies and Congress. There is no requirement or recommendation for consultation, coordination, or participation with any parties outside the federal government, such as states, tribes, or the public.
qwen_chat.s: The following unobligated balances made available to the Department of Homeland Security pursuant to Section 505 of the Department of Homeland Security Appropriations Act, 2019 (Public Law 116–6) are rescinded:
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that rescinding funds affects various agencies and thus involves coordination. However, the text is purely a fiscal directive regarding the cancellation of unobligated balances within the Department of Homeland Security. There is no mention of consulting with states, the public, or any outside entities. The actors involved are entirely within the federal government (Congress appropriating/rescinding, DHS managing funds).
